meta.title: Add main handling and faster list append for Lua transpiler
meta.body_summary: Add main function call emission, optimize append translation to mutate list in place, add pow builtin, and mark brilliant-numbers test as transpiled.

perf_labels.notes: Author self-closed immediately after a test failure noted in PR body; no benchmark or external review.

core_change_summary.description: In transpiler/x/lua/transpiler.go, modified append translation to mutate the list in place rather than copying, and added a call to main() at the end of generated Lua. Also added transpiled Lua and expected output for brilliant-numbers test.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files added for brilliant-numbers rosetta test; most line changes are in the generated Lua file.
change_trajectory: Single commit: added main handling and optimized append translation, along with test data; PR body noted a test failure (took too long and was interrupted), and PR was closed immediately by author.
